title: ✨ Meal Prep & Reheating Tips! ✨
metaDescription: Make meal time easier with planning and prepping ahead. Mastering meal prep and reheating is a game changer for any weight loss journey.
excerpt: Make meal time easier with planning and prepping ahead. Mastering meal prep and reheating is a game changer for any weight loss journey.
author: Devon RD
bodyHtml:
Meal prep is a total game changer for weight loss and healthy eating, especially when planning your weekly meals! Here’s why:
✅ Pre-portioned meals & snacks
✅ Balanced meals with protein & fiber
✅ Saves time and mental energy
✅ Helps manage temptations

💡 How to get started with meal prep:

 

    • Use single-portion containers
    • Make sure every meal has protein + fiber
    • Batch cook easy-to-reheat meals, or prep ingredients instead of full meals

 

🔥 Reheating leftovers? Don’t settle for dry, tough, or blah!
👉 Use low heat (microwave or stove)
👉 Add moisture: sprinkle water, use a lid, or a damp paper towel
👉 Stir throughout to reheat evenly
👉 Remember: Reheat to 165°F for food safety!

Stay prepared and deliciously satisfied🍽️💪✨

Want to know more about how you can start meal prepping – join Devon, RDN on Tuesday, June 10th at 6 pm for a live cooking demonstration and Q&A session all about meal prep and cooking tips. Register HERE.
